answers.core:
The built-in deferred functions would be useful to reduce large amounts of code and reduce the usage of strings in C#.

An add-on wouldn't be that useful because they're not usually updated with Godot's version.
answers.workaround: If someone doesn't want to use already deferred functions, then they still can use `CallDeferred`, but it is not that convenient.
